title: Stage - Chargé(e) de Communication Interne & Projets Collaborateurs / Engagement - H/F/X (octobre 2026)
jd:
Pionnier des ventes événementielles en ligne depuis 2001 et acteur incontournable du e-commerce en Europe, Veepee collabore avec plus de 7 000 marques pour proposer des produits à forte décote, disponibles sur une durée limitée. Présent dans de nombreux univers parmi lesquels la mode, la maison, le vin, le voyage, ou encore la beauté ... Veepee a réalisé en 2024 un chiffre d’affaires de 3,3 milliards d’euros TTC et compte 5 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 10 pays.

📄 DESCRIPTION DU POSTE

Au sein de la Direction de la Communication, vous intégrerez le pôle Communication Interne & Éditorial de Veepee. Vous serez plus particulièrement chargé(e) de contribuer à la valorisation des initiatives liées aux collaborateurs, qu’il s’agisse d’informations clés RH, de programmes internes, d’actions de développement, ou encore de projets transverses portant sur l’engagement, la culture d’entreprise et la RSE.

 

Accompagné(e) d’une cheffe de projet, vous prendrez en autonomie un périmètre de communications internes à forte dimension “collaborateurs”, en lien avec différents interlocuteurs métiers (dont les équipes RH), tout en participant à la mise en place d’événements et d’actions internes.

 

Votre rôle mêlera coordination, production éditoriale, création visuelle et gestion opérationnelle de projets

🎯 MISSIONS

1. Gestion d’un périmètre de communication interne orienté “initiatives collaborateurs”

Structurer et accompagner les besoins de communication sur les sujets liés à la vie interne : programmes, informations clés, actualités, dispositifs collaborateurs…

Collecter et formaliser les briefs auprès des équipes concernées (People, développement interne, learning, engagement…).

Rédiger et diffuser les contenus sur les canaux internes :e-mails, posts Slack, articles intranet, communications visuelles de messages pédagogiques ou informatifs diffusés sur les écrans dynamiques.

Assurer la cohérence éditoriale et proposer des formats adaptés selon les audiences.

 

2. Coordination & gestion de projets transverses (RSE, engagement, culture d’entreprise)

Participer à la conception et à l’animation d’actions internes : moments forts RSE, Marronnier RH, campagnes de sensibilisation, initiatives d’engagement, projets menés avec le Fonds Veepee.

Gérer les aspects opérationnels de communication : planning, coordination des parties prenantes, suivi logistique et diffusion.

 

3. Création de contenus & design

Concevoir des supports visuels variés : infographies, visuels pour écrans, bannières, mini-guides, éléments pour l’intranet…

Décliner des messages en formats visuels adaptés, principalement via Canva.

Veiller à la cohérence graphique avec l’identité visuelle de Veepee.

👉 MUST HAVE SKILLS

Étudiant(e) en Bac+4/5 en communication / RH, école de commerce  ou formation équivalente.

Intérêt marqué pour la communication interne, la vie d’entreprise et les projets à impact collaborateurs (développement RH, engagement, inclusion, culture…).

Excellente plume et capacité à vulgariser des sujets variés.

Très bonne maîtrise de Canva, et/ou d’outils de PAO.

Organisation, rigueur, sens des priorités et autonomie.

Aisance relationnelle : coordination, prise de briefs, interactions régulières avec divers métiers.

Créatif(ve), curieux(se), force de proposition et à l’aise avec les outils digitaux.

Anglais courant indispensable.

✅ BENEFITS

👉Bureau flexible avec au minimum 3 jours sur place et jusqu'à 2 jours à domicile

👉Plate-forme d'apprentissage des langues en ligne

👉Comité d’entreprise CE et ses nombreux avantages

👉Accès à une restauration d'entreprise et cantine connecté

👉Accès à la Salle de sport

👉Congés selon la durée du contrat

⚙️RECRUITMENT PROCESS

1️⃣ Entretien téléphonique RH (30 mins)

2️⃣ Entretien visio avec le manager (1h)

title: Engineer Electrical Engineering ‒ Electrical Grids & Grid Integration
jd:
The Fraunhofer\-Gesellschaft (www.fraunhofer.com) is one of the world's leading organizations for application\-oriented research. 74 institutes develop pioneering technologies for our economy and society – more precisely: 30 000 people from technology, science, administration and IT. They know: Anyone who comes to Fraunhofer wants to and can make a difference. For themselves, for us and for the markets of today and tomorrow.

At the Fraunhofer Institute for Wind Energy Systems IWES, the energy transition becomes a reality every day. Our focus topics are: offshore wind energy, hydrogen, test infrastructure and digitization. More than 400 employees – including around 100 students – from over 50 countries work at nine locations in scientific and non\-scientific teams on the development of innovative methods to accelerate the expansion of the wind energy and hydrogen economy, minimize risks, and increase cost efficiency. Do you want to join us in shaping a sustainable future?

  

**Be part of change**

You will join our "Power Electronics and Grid Integration" group at our site in Bremerhaven. Our work deals with the grid integration of wind turbines as well as wind farms and hybrid farms. At present, the team consists of five employees and several students. We support each other irrespective of our projects and backgrounds. A culture of open exchange and cooperation, even beyond team boundaries and sites, are particularly important to us.

  

You will be involved in various research and industry projects, with duties ranging from supporting the commissioning of a converter test bench to optimizing and expanding other test benches with a special focus on the “Power Hardware\-in\-the\-loop (PHiL)” approach. While working with various real\-time systems and setting up grid models, you will develop test methods to generate measurement data for the validation of harmonic and EMT models. To present your results to the public, you will write scientific reports and publications.

  

You will take on project management tasks and, over time, also lead research and development projects. In addition, you will work on the test bench and actively engage in the preparation of a test campaign. Throughout all these projects, you will be in close contact with national and international customers and project partners.

  

**What you contribute**

You have completed your diploma or master’s degree in the field of Electrical Engineering, Power Engineering, Control Engineering, Mechatronics, or Engineering Management specializing in one of the subjects mentioned above. You are familiar with control engineering and grid modeling, at least in theory? Do you have a basic understanding of electrical energy systems and power electronics? Have you already used MATLAB and PSCAD? Perfect!

  

Understanding and working in research is not enough, you also want to put your results into words and present them? Great! Perhaps you have worked on test benches before and know the challenges that may arise. But do not worry if you do not have all those skills just yet, you can also get your career off to a flying start with us. If you do already have experience, you can build upon it. Here at IWES, we operate on an international level – a good command of German and English is important for your day\-to\-day work.

  

**What we offer**

We support you on your professional journey. Whether personally, professionally, or methodically, we find the right qualification measures for you. It is also possible to be responsible for your own doctorate here. We offer you our full support! Do you want to immerse yourself in additional fields and work independently to drive new topics forward? With us, you get to shape your range of duties actively!

  

Our open institute culture as well as mutual tolerance and respect ensure that every person feels comfortable with us from the start. We achieve this, for example, through our onboarding program for new employees as well as by raising awareness of and providing training on diversity and equal opportunity issues. We firmly believe that diversity is key to our success. Join us and experience this for yourself!

  

Our flextime and core time system allows you to plan your working day flexibly. In addition, you also have the option to work remotely. Not sure who can look after your children in an emergency? We help by offering emergency childcare. Interested in employee discounts for events, clothes, vacations, etc.? With us, you can select from a varied range of offers and easily take advantage of them for yourself via an app. For sustainable mobility, you can also benefit from the Deutschland\-Ticket as a job ticket.

  

If you would like to find out more information about the IWES, our research aspects, and your future colleagues, please visit our career website: https://s.fhg.de/5ei

  

The position is limited to 3 years. The weekly working time is 39 hours. This position is also available on a part\-time basis, preferably close to full\-time. Appointment, remuneration and social security benefits based on the public\-sector collective wage agreement (TVöD). Additionally Fraunhofer may grant performance\-based variable remuneration components.

  

We value and promote the diversity of our employees' skills and therefore welcome all applications – regardless of age, gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, ideology, disability, sexual orientation and identity. Severely disabled persons are given preference in the event of equal suitability.

  

Our tasks are diverse and adaptable – for applicants with disabilities, we work together to find solutions that best promote their abilities.

  

With its focus on developing key technologies that are vital for the future and enabling the commercial utilization of this work by business and industry, Fraunhofer plays a central role in the innovation process. As a pioneer and catalyst for groundbreaking developments and scientific excellence, Fraunhofer helps shape society now and in the future.
